This morning I tested the online ballot platform and confirmed that it records each voter's identity for 90 days, and that feature cannot be disabled. This creates a serious privacy concern for a student election. The approved workaround is to use sealed paper ballots counted by two adults, with zero electronic voter records. I have not yet updated the election plan to reflect this change, so the draft you have still references the online ballot. This needs to be incorporated before approval.

I've kept the review in my counseling file since it contains protected student information, and I have not yet briefed you on it until now. This means the draft plan's publication of vote totals at the end of election day needs to be changed — vote totals cannot be released until the election is certified. This must be incorporated before approval.
